description: A skin nodule complicated by secondary infection or inflammation.
causes: Secondary bacterial infection of an underlying nodule or cyst

appearance.general: A red, swollen, tender nodule that may become fluctuant or drain pus.

warning_signs: Rapid spread, fever, severe pain, or tissue breakdown requires medical evaluation.
general_first_aid: Do not squeeze or puncture an infected nodule.
Keep the area clean and protected.
